sentences.en: The width of the road is insufficient for safe driving.
sentences.zh: 这条道路的宽度不足以保证安全驾驶。

sentences.en: Cut the bread into diagonal slices the width of a finger.
sentences.zh: 把面包切成手指宽的斜切片。

sentences.en: Pluto is only about half the width of the United States.
sentences.zh: 冥王星的直径大约只有美国的一半宽。

senses.zh: 宽度, 阔度, 广度 - 宽, 广
